task.description:
Perform root cause diagnosis for ISS-0112 per WF-03 Step 1 protocol. Confirm that webhook_subscriptions.secret_ref column is missing in per-tenant schemas because:
1. GBL-128_exp501_secrets.sql (lines 67-76) adds secret_ref only IF webhook_subscriptions exists in the schema it runs against
2. GBL-128 is a GBL-prefixed migration, which runs ONLY against public schema per src/db/migrations.zig
3. webhook_subscriptions was dropped from public by GBL-073
4. Therefore GBL-128's IF check fails and secret_ref is never added
5. GBL-133 attempts to fix this (lines 200-204) but only for public schema, not per-tenant schemas

Verify this diagnosis by:
- Checking which tenants have SCHEMA storage mode
- Confirming secret_ref column is missing in their webhook_subscriptions tables
- Confirming the column exists in public (or public.webhook_subscriptions doesn't exist)

Write diagnosis summary to docs/issue-reports/ISS-0112-diagnosis-20260804.yaml
acceptance_criteria: Root cause confirmed via schema introspection
Resolution strategy identified: create corrective migration to add secret_ref to per-tenant webhook_subscriptions tables
Failure scope quantified (how many tenants affected)

result.summary: Root cause diagnosis confirmed for ISS-0112. webhook_subscriptions.secret_ref is missing in 1 SCHEMA-mode tenant schema (tenant_default) because GBL-128 migration's conditional guard (IF to_regclass('webhook_subscriptions') IS NOT NULL) evaluates to FALSE in public schema (table dropped by GBL-073), and neither GBL-128 nor GBL-133 apply DDL to tenant schemas. Resolution strategy: create corrective migration to add secret_ref column to webhook_subscriptions in all SCHEMA-mode tenant schemas.
